title: HateBench in the Era of Safer LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (F1 scores, accuracy, false positives) of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated content targeting various racial and ethnic groups.
Evaluating the performance of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated content targeting different religious groups (e.g., Atheist, Buddhists, Christians, Hindus, Jews, Muslims, Mormons).
Evaluating the performance of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated content targeting immigrants, migrant workers, undocumented people, and refugees.
Evaluating the performance of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated content targeting different gender identities including men, women, transgender, and non-binary individuals.

Evaluating the performance of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated content targeting bisexual, gay, lesbian, and heterosexual individuals, specifically highlighting high false positive rates for certain identity terms like 'gay'.
Evaluating the performance of hate speech detectors on LLM-generated content targeting people with physical, cognitive, visual, hearing, and mental health disabilities.
